newsitem.title: NAMIBIA: Namibian stocks week - Shares slip in heavy trade.
newsitem.headline: Namibian stocks week - Shares slip in heavy trade.

text.p: Namibia's two share indices slipped last week driven down by lower prices in several larger stocks but volumes were high as buyers snapped shares at lower levels.
The Overall Index slipped to 223.72 from 233.03 a week earlier and the Local Index fell to 148.76 from 152.17.
Active business saw 1,1 million Pep Namibia shares traded at N$4.35 each and Namibian Sea Products traded at a low of 69 cents.
The total value of shares traded in the week was N$70.2 million with a volume of 6,809,592 shares.
